name: Better Percentage Plus
description: Run from and best run next to the percentage, with a toggle to show the % symbol only when playing from 0%

decimals.name: Decimal Places
decimals.description: Amount of decimal places on the percentage

percent-symbol-only-from-zero.name: Percent Symbol Only From 0%
percent-symbol-only-from-zero.description: Shows the % symbol when playing from 0%, and hides it when playing from a startpos

show-run-from.name: Show Run From
show-run-from.description: Shows the run start next to the progress percentage

hide-run-from-from-zero.name: Hide Run From From Zero
hide-run-from-from-zero.description: Hides the run start when playing from 0%

show-best-run.name: Show Best Run
show-best-run.description: Shows the best run next to the progress percentage

hide-best-run-from-zero.name: Hide Best Run From Zero
hide-best-run-from-zero.description: Hides the best run when playing from 0%

show-level-best-from-zero.name: Show Level Best From Zero
show-level-best-from-zero.description: Shows the level best instead of best run when playing from 0%
